About the temple

Shri Shyam Mandir at Khatu, in Rajasthan's Sikar district, is the principal dhaam of Khatu Shyam Ji. Lakhs of devotees walk here for the Phalguna mela every year, carrying nishans that are tied at the temple.

About Khatu Shyam

Khatu Shyam Ji is Barbarik of the Mahabharata, grandson of Bhima. He offered his own head to Shri Krishna as dakshina, and Krishna blessed him to be worshipped in Kaliyuga under His own name, Shyam — Haare ka Sahara, the refuge of those who feel defeated.

Why offer this seva?
1
Haare ka sahara
Devotees turn to Shyam Baba when a matter feels lost or stuck.
2
Peace at home
Gulab jal and ittar are offered the way one welcomes a beloved guest.
3
Guruvar visesh
This week's seva is offered with Thursday's evening aarti at Khatu.

About the mandir
Shri Mahalakshmi (Ambabai) Mandir, Kolhapur (Maharashtra)

Shri Mahalakshmi Mandir in Kolhapur, called Ambabai by devotees, is one of the Shakti Peethas described in the Puranas. The temple is built in black stone in the Hemadpanthi style and is believed to date back over a thousand years.

The murti of Maa Mahalakshmi is carved in precious black stone and faces west. During Kiranotsav, the setting sun falls directly on the deity for a few days each year, and Navratri brings lakhs of devotees to Kolhapur.

Why keep this seva?
1
Lakshmi stays where she is welcomed
In tradition, kumkum and laal chunri are how a home welcomes Maa Lakshmi. Offering them every Friday invites her to stay, not just visit.
2
Relief from money worries
Devotees keep this seva when income feels unsteady, debts weigh heavy or savings never seem to last.
3
Shukra made strong
Friday belongs to Shukra, the graha of comfort and fortune. Seva on this day is kept to strengthen it, as per Jyotish.
4
From a Shakti Peetha
Your offering is made at Mahalakshmi Kolhapur, one of the most powerful seats of the Devi in Bharat, not at a local shrine.
5
Proof, every single time
You see your seva being offered on video and receive a certificate. Faith, with nothing left to doubt.
